pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented and densely clustered patches toward the hindquarters and lower legs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected lattice of light-cream pathways. Junction nodes exhibit high-frequency 3-way and 4-way intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the mid-dorsal region, narrowing on the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck line, creating a fine-grained sawtooth 1D contour against the background.
